# Y2K Theme Showcase

Welcome to the **Y2K** theme showcase for MemWault. Inspired by the turn of the millennium, this theme features brushed metal textures, vibrant blues, and the optimistic tech-bubble aesthetic of the early 2000s.

The dashboard uses high-contrast borders and brushed chrome effects.
